purpose: Record the JWT/bearer factor's native cryptographic boundary for future owner review without attempting to translate cryptography into Fungi.

source.signature: export function bearerTokenVerdict(headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, opts: BearerVerifyOptions): Verdict
source.classification: exported K3 authentication factor with native crypto, key-object and JWT parsing obligations

nativeDependencies.hostBoundary: Cryptographic verification remains in the native host; Fungi may consume an independently verified result only when an exact boundary contract authorizes that shape.
nativeDependencies.architectureEvidence: docs/architecture/roadmap-2026-07-11.md describes core-security and cryptographic primitives as the frozen host/compute floor rather than Fungi twin candidates

builtOracle.role: locally rebuilt differential oracle only; native crypto remains the execution authority

coveredBehavior: HS256, RS256 and EdDSA valid tokens
algorithm pinning, alg:none refusal and key-family mismatch
required expiry, clock tolerance and invalid clock handling
signature tampering, wrong secret and malformed JWT refusal
unsupported ES algorithms and empty algorithm configuration fail closed

translationAssessment.candidateShape: JWT compact parsing and claims policy around native HMAC/RSA/EdDSA verification; this is a host-floor boundary rather than a pure Fungi decision fold
translationAssessment.inputStateContract: Readonly header records, algorithm arrays, key strings/bytes/KeyObjects, optional clock/issuer/audience and signed token bytes all have observable runtime and failure behavior
operationLedger: locate and classify the bearer header
split and base64url-decode the compact token
parse JOSE header and enforce caller-pinned algorithm
delegate signature verification to node:crypto with key-family checks
parse and validate temporal, issuer and audience claims
return ALLOW, DENY or INDETERMINATE without making kernel admission
reusableEvidence: graph-resolved complexity and native call dependencies
native crypto module and built-oracle identities are recorded
architecture guidance keeps cryptographic primitives in the host/compute floor
retirement register has no Fungi replacement or execution authority
missingProofs: exact owner-authorized scope decision distinguishing host adapter work from Fungi translation
cryptographic ABI and provenance contract for any Fungi-consumed verification result
differential vectors for every parser, claim, key-object and crypto failure order
constant-time and key-type security review outside the Fungi interpreter
bounded physical SLIDE/VOK evidence for the chosen host boundary
proof that no host-precomputed Verdict becomes a hidden admission authority

decision: Treat this as non-authorizing host-floor evidence. Keep bearerTokenVerdict BLOCKED:DOSSIER_REQUIRED and do not translate native cryptography into Fungi unless a fresh exact-head owner admission defines an explicit host-boundary scope and all cryptographic and authority gates pass.
